JANUS HENDERSON FUND MANAGEMENT UK LIMITED
The Board of Lowland Investment Company plc announces that:

A third interim dividend of 1.75p per Ordinary Share, in respect of the year ending 30 September 2026, is to be paid on 30 October 2026 to holders registered at the close of business on 25 September 2026. This compares with the dividend of 1.65p per Ordinary Share for the same period last year.
The Company's shares will trade ex-dividend on 24 September 2026.
